title: Superbubble LHA 120-N 44 in the Large Magellanic Cloud
caption: The superbubble LHA 120-N 44 around the star cluster NGC 1929, imaged by ESO's Very Large Telescope
celestial: LHA 120-N 44, NGC 1929 · constellation Dorado · about 170000 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: This view from ESO's Very Large Telescope shows the nebula LHA 120-N 44, which surrounds the star cluster NGC 1929. The region lies in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy that orbits our own Milky Way.

N 44 is a place where stars are being born, and its most prominent feature is a colossal superbubble, a vast cavity of material that is expanding outward. The driving force is the cluster of young stars at the bubble's heart. Massive young stars pour out intense radiation and powerful winds, and many end their lives in supernova explosions, all of which can push surrounding gas outward.
In this way the cluster sculpts the interstellar landscape around it and pushes the nebula's evolution forward. The same stars that formed from the cloud end up reshaping it.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (5.97 x 6.77 arcminutes) and distance (170000 light years), the frame spans roughly 295 × 335 light-years. Its light set out about 170,000 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: FORS1 on the Very Large Telescope imaged the nebula through narrow filters isolating ionized helium, doubly ionized oxygen, neutral helium and hydrogen-alpha light. The source does not publish which color was assigned to each filter.
filters: 467 nm · Optical Heii (Very Large Telescope FORS1)

understand.eye: The narrow filters isolate the glow of particular gases, and the telescope's exposures reveal faint structure in another galaxy that the eye could not see.

explore: The region lies about 170,000 light-years away. The image was taken with the FORS1 instrument through filters that pick out light from helium, oxygen and hydrogen. It is credited to ESO and Manu Mejias.
alt: A nebula surrounding a cluster of young stars, featuring a vast expanding superbubble.
